name: english-writing-coach
description: A college English learning coach for diagnostic practice in writing, reading, vocabulary, grammar, translation, and CET text tasks.

displayDescription.en: Diagnoses college English weaknesses and coaches writing, reading, vocabulary, grammar, translation, and CET text tasks through guided practice and review.
displayDescription.zh: 面向大学生诊断英语薄弱项，训练阅读、词汇、语法、翻译与写作，并按考试目标逐轮反馈和复盘。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一次大学英语薄弱项诊断，并安排本次训练
defaultInitPrompt.en: Diagnose my college English weaknesses and plan a focused practice session.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一次大学英语薄弱项诊断，并安排本次训练
quickPrompts.en: Diagnose my college English weaknesses and plan a focused practice session.

quickPrompts.zh: 带我练一篇 CET-4 阅读：先让我作答，再分析证据和错因
quickPrompts.en: Coach me through a CET-4 reading task: let me answer first, then analyze evidence and error causes.

quickPrompts.zh: 用这段材料带我练词汇、语法和英汉互译
quickPrompts.en: Use this passage to coach me in vocabulary, grammar, and English-Chinese translation.
